teacher_changes.summary: V22 V2 T2: Three independent placement pathways replacing single grasp-transition heuristic
changes: 1. compute_grasp_state: added contact_established (sustained contact WITHOUT tight qpos>0.7 requirement)
2. compute_placement_state: (a) tight-grasp release, (b) contact-only release with gripper opening, (c) terminal proximity fallback
3. Target name fallback: _contain_region suffix resolved to base object name
4. compute_safe_release: uses contact_established for release event detection

gap_analysis.remaining_14_unsuccessful_placements: Object distance to target region center > 0.35 at all points in last 30% of episode. Region targets (basket_contain_region, plate) have positions in qpos that don't represent actual placement locations. Distance-based heuristic inherently limited for region targets.
gap_analysis.fundamental_limitation: BDDL target positions are region centers, not object resting positions. Objects placed in baskets/plates end up 0.3-0.6 units from region center. No purely distance-based check can achieve 90% recall without excessive false positives.
possible_next_steps: A: Use Z-height stabilization near support surface instead of XY distance to target
B: Use object-motion-stability (velocity < threshold) in terminal window
C: Accept 65% recall, supplement with object-Z criterion
D: Redefine placement success criterion for T2: object-near-target OR object-on-support-surface

next_gate: T3_SCIENTIFIC_CONTRACT_V2 (can proceed with 65% recall, document limitation)
